previous similar request https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/allow-instance-owners-to-change-world-caps

voting systems are unnecessarily complicated. being able to just set it at creation (and maybe in the future to change it later) would be MUCH easier to implement and would solve the vast vast majority of cases.

details:
some worlds have a very low user cap, why not have a way to raise that cap? maybe it can be a "Group Leaders only" feature!

How

when an instance reaches the recommended amount of users or the maximum world limit, there could be a moderators-only-vote in the instance every 2h to decide whether to expand the maximum by 10, if all moderators vote yes, then the limit of that instance raises by 10, if it happens again it can be raised again and again until reaching 80/80.

Why

there is one thing that truly calms me down and gives me a sense of peace like nothing else: going to worlds that have 80+- people, and so far i have only seen one like that, the pug, the pug can reach 80 users in an instance, and that feel so nice, because you can literally hear how full is the instance, it feels like a real place, it feels like anything could happen, and that's what i like about it!

Negatives

phone users and quest users may lag, but they can always avoid showing all avatars and maybe only show impostors at close range, or they can join another instance.

Advantages

the more the people you have in one instance, the more it feels alive, the less your instance is empty, the better the chances to find good people, additionally if is a big event that you are planning to host (like a "singing contest" or dj party rave) you can either have spoof instances connected to a main instance (which is not always possible) or you can have a bigger user cap so more can attend.

Additionally

this is an incentive for people to run instances longer, as you will get this advantage unlocked after some time, it also makes it easier for groups to grow, as it shows that the group can handle it, then if only staff can agree to raise the cap in the specific instance only, it will avoid that people open unmoderated instances with random groups.

Why should you want it

i think many worlds could run just fine with more people, then it is up to you to decide if to support it or not.
title: Instance Cap Override
